name: algo-solve-vscode
description: Solve algorithmic tasks using local Ollama models

algoSolve.destinationDirectory.description: Directory where solutions will be saved (empty = active file workspace folder)

algoSolve.outputFileBaseName.description: Override base name for generated solution files (empty = derive from active file name)

algoSolve.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model to use for code generation

algoSolve.prompt.default:
You are an expert algorithm solver. Analyze the following problem description and provide a complete, working solution in {language}.

Problem:
{content}

Requirements:
- Provide clean, well-commented code
- Include proper error handling
- Optimize for time and space complexity where possible
- Return only the code implementation

Solution:

algoSolve.refinePrompt.default:
You are an expert programmer. Use the instruction below to refine the code in {language}.

Instruction:
{instruction}

Code:
{codeBody}

Rules:
- Treat the instruction as the source of truth.
- If the code section is empty, generate a complete solution from the instruction alone.
- If both instruction and code are present, modify only what is needed to satisfy the instruction.
- Return only the final code, with no explanation.
algoSolve.refinePrompt.description: Prompt template for refinements (use {language}, {instruction}, and {codeBody} placeholders; {context} is still supported as a legacy combined alias)

algoSolve.showNotifications.description: If true, show a progress notification and error messages while solving. If false (default), run silently and log errors only.
